subject: I'm Laughing.
author: SUFFUR
body:
Takes a breath...

Hang on,...

... gets off the floor...

Right...

 ...breath damn you...

something nice...

...

wait for it...

...well...

...damn, I'm getting old...

Where was I...

You studied us under a microscope, saw where we were good, adopted it and made it your own, you were never an appentice, just a master that was blinded by the boost.

Welcome to the addiction.

...sorry started laughing again...

till next time.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

body: You are sooooooooooo full of it mr nitolicious...........lolololol.....new to this game my rear end.....although i have to admit judging by your racing standards earlier this morning you proved that maybe you still have a long long way to go yet.....lol.....if youd have joined my room like 1 hour earlier it was amazing i had 2 of my favourite racers in there....MyHandMyLover....Shaeffer...Churx2....{cough cough} even Flaco Boi joined for 1 set {got owned and left}...but the race before you joined was the best because the other 3 racers were ranked over 1000 me Hand and Shaeff decided to give them a chance and go in Low Riders well with a 250 rank under my belt i thought id better be on my game here and to my surprise i won every race hands down.....it was awesome.....thats why when you joined they went in crappy cars....i think Hands rank went to 1100 from 200....RESULT....😉..Damn i wish all my favourite racers would join me more of a morning...🙁....i then jumped into an unranked room with NetterNet..Eezo...Scandelous...KillaKane and ImStinky.....man them guys are so funny to run with i mean the conversation went from racing to blow up dolls?......WTF lmfao.....anyway Welcome Nito im sure youll love it in here you get to write wayyyyyy more than what you can over the wall.....oh and ill enjoy reading what youve posted about speed as im now using the STICK {cough cough} occasionally lol i need all the advice i can get...😉
